revised_contract: No blocked placeholder is reachability. Every promoted command must own one exact source operation identity, method, path template, typed request schemas, bounded values, existing policy, and real provider I/O. No caller-selected raw URL, verb, headers, body, or arbitrary JSON is permitted.

schema_import_gate.requirement: The current source-lock files retain identity, URL, byte count, hash, and operation inventory but not a checked-in raw OpenAPI payload. Before any operation is promoted, source-contract materialization must retrieve the public artifact and prove its bytes and SHA-256 equal the lock; a drift is a source-lock refresh decision, never a schema guess.

operation_identity_derivation: source_id is the connector-owned exact identity.
